items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: Milt Hinton being one [of my great role models]

ctx.x: Well you can’t sit still, that’s for sure.

No, there’s no way. I mean I’ve had great role models in my life. Milt Hinton being one, Clark Terry being another. I shouldn’t even start naming names. I’ve had a lot of good role models that man, if you’ve been given this gift of being able to play and you like people, what better? It would take a couple of million dollars and maybe not even that to make me stop doing what I’m doing. Just, it’s a great way.
Well I’ve enjoyed talking to you.
